# Addy Osmani

Engineer who led Chrome developer experience and web performance work at Google, author of *Learning JavaScript Design Patterns*, and, per the video, recently moved to Anthropic. He open-sourced `agent-skills`, which passed 100K GitHub stars.

## Background

Widely regarded in the JavaScript and web performance world. The video describes his skills as "a seasoned engineer's brain compressed into markdown".

## Key ideas

- A six-stage lifecycle for agents: Define, Plan, Build, Verify, Review, Ship, covering CI/CD, observability and deprecation. It reads as the traditional software development lifecycle done properly with an agent.
- 25 skills plus 4 reviewer personas (staff engineer, test engineer, security auditor, web performance auditor); a `/build auto` mode that keeps verification.
- The [[Anti-Rationalization Table]] and [[Doubt-Driven Development]].
- A gradual, verification-first rollout on an existing codebase; do not install all 25 skills at once. See [[Skill Pack]].
